method: Editorial reading aid | source pinpoints checked locally

sections.label: Charge
sections.summary: Aiding and abetting intentional homicide. This was an allegation, not a conviction.

sections.label: What was at stake
sections.summary: Taken into custody on 14 January 1977; released on 1 March 1977. A discharge order followed in 1980. The judgment does not record a prosecutor-requested prison term.

sections.label: Presumption of innocence
sections.summary: Senior police officials publicly identified the applicant as a murder instigator before the competent court assessed the facts.

sections.label: Court's conclusion
sections.summary: The Court found an Article 6(2) breach. It also found excessive length of compensation proceedings under Article 6(1). The award was FRF 2 million for damage, plus costs; this is compensation, not a criminal penalty.

sections.label: For a lawyer reviewing a new matter
sections.summary: Compare the speaker's official role, exact words, timing and audience. Distinguish an unequivocal declaration of guilt from information about an investigation. This regional judgment is a comparison, not a prediction of UN review success.
